faqs.question: Do you provide actual dieline blueprints for manufacturing?
faqs.answer: Yes, we engineer millimeter-accurate vector dielines including fold lines, bleed allowances, glue tabs, and finish masks ready for direct manufacturer production.

faqs.question: Can you design for sustainable and eco-friendly substrates?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We specialize in FSC-certified duplex boards, recyclable corrugated flutes, compostable barrier films, and soy-based ink systems.

faqs.question: Do you create 3D renders before print production?
faqs.answer: Yes, we produce photorealistic 3D renders with realistic studio reflections and foil shaders so you can inspect every angle prior to committing to print runs.
